rules.name: The White-led Rule
rules.body: Keep the broad page canvas white or soft neutral. Concentrated red belongs to actions, emphasis, selected states, and the closing contact band.

rules.name: Flat tonal depth
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and dividers; the implemented system has no box-shadow vocabulary.

rules.name: Keyboard focus
rules.body: Retain the global 3px primary outline with 5px offset. Fields use a 2px primary outline with 2px offset and primary border.

rules.name: Responsive containment
rules.body: Keep rate tables inside their horizontal scroll wrapper and preserve mobile stacking and usable navigation.

dos: Do preserve the approved white corporate world, Cargo red, black type, limited yellow, and alpaca identity.
Do use the shared typography, rounded actions, calm borders, and responsive container.
donts: Don't reintroduce the dark full-screen photo-overlay hero or the unselected promotional-poster direction.
Don't substitute Prompt for Noto Sans Thai and Inter.
Don't introduce decorative shadows as a default surface treatment.
